responsibility: Implements the SLP vectorizer’s core data structures and algorithms for basic-block vectorization and loop-aware SLP. It owns allocation and lifetime of slp_tree/slp_instance objects, construction and teardown of SLP graphs, permutation and node analysis, scheduling of vector code for trees including SCC/PHI-cycle handling, and final emission/cleanup of SLP-generated statements and vectorized stores, making it the main engine for intra-iteration vectorization once statements have been grouped into SLP trees.
